name: Gorou
source:
Classmate of [url=/c89999]Kuzumi[/url] at Rindoukan Academy with an impressive appearance.
He tried in vain to win the favor of girls, and has recently resorted to learning fortune-telling in order to gain chances of communicating with girls.
